niche: Psychology & human behavior (biases, habits, social dynamics)

ideas.title: Why Your Brain Can't Let Go of Unfinished Tasks
ideas.angle: The video explains the Zeigarnik Effect, where your brain creates a state of mental tension that only resolves when a task is completed, which is why your to-do list feels physically heavy.

hook.fr: Ton cerveau déteste les tâches inachevées.

ideas.reason: Productivity and 'brain fog' topics are currently surging on social media as users seek cognitive reasons for burnout. The Zeigarnik Effect is a proven psychological pillar for engagement.
sources: British Psychological Society - The Zeigarnik Effect
Journal of Personality and Social Psychology

ideas.title: The Secret Trick Behind Every Menu
ideas.angle: The video reveals the 'Decoy Effect' where companies add a third, expensive option just to make the middle option look like a bargain, forcing your brain into a predictable choice.

hook.fr: Tu ne choisis pas vraiment librement.

ideas.reason: Consumer behavior videos have high retention rates because they reveal a 'secret' about everyday life. Financial psychology is a high-CPM niche with global appeal.

ideas.title: Why Your Clumsiness Makes You Likable
ideas.angle: The video illustrates the Pratfall Effect, showing that highly competent people who make a small mistake or trip are perceived as more attractive and relatable than those who are perfect.

hook.en: Being perfect makes people dislike you.
hook.fr: Être parfait te rend moins aimable.

ideas.reason: Social dynamics and 'how to be likable' content performs exceptionally well in the Arabic and European markets where social hierarchy and etiquette are highly valued.
sources: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology - The Pratfall Effect
